interface.title: BasinLens CCS
interface.field: Geologic carbon storage (CCS) / subsurface reservoir screening
interface.stage_of_work: Early conceptual screening of candidate storage sites, before detailed characterization
interface.what_it_is_for: Runs a seeded Monte Carlo volumetric CO2 storage-capacity simulation over a batch of site scenarios (inputs given as triangular low/mode/high estimates), then shows Q10/Q50/Q90 capacity per site, a rank-correlation sensitivity breakdown, and a demonstration-only containment-attention score with its components.

data.note: On load with no upload, the app ran on the 3 built-in synthetic demo sites (Aurora, Borealis, Caldera). I then uploaded custom_site_scenarios.csv (VERDANT, RIFTMARK, QUIETBED, OUTLIER) and synthetic_sites.csv. Uploading synthetic_sites.csv gave the same numbers as the built-in default.

tree.general: Screen a batch of candidate items under uncertainty and decide which ones need further investigation
tree.specific: Screen conceptual CO2 storage sites by Monte Carlo storage capacity (Q10/Q50/Q90), find which input drives each site's uncertainty, and flag sites with a high containment-attention score

features.name: Seeded Monte Carlo run settings with live rerun
features.general: Set the sample size and random seed of a stochastic simulation. Every result view recomputes, and the same seed gives the same numbers again.
features.specific: The Monte Carlo samples per site slider (1000–100000, step 1000) and the Random seed number input (type, or press −/+) rerun the volumetric capacity simulation for all sites. The table, metric cards and charts all update. Seed 42 with 20000 samples gave the same Q10/Q50/Q90 again.
steps: drag or click the sample-count slider (or use arrow keys)
type a seed or press +/−
wait for the dashboard to rerun
compare quantiles to judge sampling noise or reproduce an earlier run
serves_tasks: Set the sample size and random seed for the stochastic run, then rerun
Confirm that a run can be reproduced from its seed

features.name: CSV scenario upload with fallback to bundled example
features.general: Upload a table of items to analyse. If nothing is uploaded, or the upload is removed, the tool falls back to a built-in example set.
features.specific: The sidebar file uploader (CSV, 200MB) replaces the three synthetic demo sites with the uploaded site scenarios (triangular inputs plus caprock, fault distance and legacy-well density). Removing the file brings back the demo sites. The previous sort order and run settings stay as they were.
steps: press Upload and choose a CSV
check the overview table lists the new sites
optionally rerun with new samples/seed
press the remove (x) on the file to go back to the demo set
serves_tasks: Load your own set of items to screen
Start from a bundled example dataset

features.name: Sortable, searchable summary table
features.general: Rank and filter a per-item results table by any column, search its text, and choose which columns to show.
features.specific: The Concept screening overview data table (Site, Q10/Q50/Q90 capacity, Attention score, Attention category). The table content is app logic. Sort, Search and Show/hide columns are stock Streamlit data-table controls: click a header to sort ascending or descending, use Search to highlight matching cells and count results, and use the Show/hide columns menu to toggle columns.
steps: click a column header to sort (again to reverse)
press Search and type text to highlight matches
open Show/hide columns and untick or tick columns
use Fullscreen for a larger view
serves_tasks: Compare the low/median/high estimates and follow-up flags across items
Rank, search and trim the comparison table

features.name: Item selector driving a linked detail panel (quantile cards + distribution histogram)
features.general: Pick one item from a list. Its summary statistics and the histogram of its simulated outcomes (with the median marked) appear below, and you can zoom, inspect or enlarge the chart.
features.specific: App logic: the Inspect a site selectbox updates the Q10/Q50/Q90 metric cards and the Monte Carlo capacity distribution histogram (dashed median line). Framework chrome: the stock Plotly toolbar, which provides box zoom (double-click resets), hover bin counts, fullscreen and PNG download on every chart.
steps: choose a site in Inspect a site
read the Q10/Q50/Q90 cards
hover bins or drag a box to zoom the histogram
double-click to reset or press Fullscreen
serves_tasks: View one item's simulated output distribution and quantiles
Save a chart as an image

features.name: Rank-correlation sensitivity (tornado-style) chart
features.general: For the selected item, show which uncertain inputs most influence the simulated output, as sorted bars of rank correlation, with exact values on hover.
features.specific: Sensitivity to uncertain inputs: horizontal bars of rank correlation between capacity and storage area, net thickness, porosity, CO2 density and storage efficiency, sorted by strength. The order changes per site (Aurora: efficiency > thickness > area; Caldera: efficiency > area > thickness). The bars are empty for the zero-uncertainty QUIETBED site. PNG export is the shared Plotly toolbar (see f4), not part of this component.
steps: select a site
read the bar order to find the dominant driver
hover a bar for its exact rank correlation
serves_tasks: Find which uncertain input drives the output's uncertainty

features.name: Transparent composite score with component breakdown
features.general: Show an item's overall flag score (0–100) and category next to a bar chart of the sub-indicators that make it up, so the reason for a flag can be read directly.
features.specific: Illustrative containment-attention indicators: a headline category and score (e.g. 'Very high attention — 82.8/100') and the Transparent heuristic components bar chart for Caprock, Fault Proximity and Legacy Wells. Hovering a bar shows its value (Caldera Fault Proximity 97.78).
steps: select a site
read the attention category and score
compare the component bars
hover a bar for its exact value
serves_tasks: See why an item is flagged for follow-up by breaking a composite score into its parts

features.name: Run summary export
features.general: Download a per-item summary of the current run as a CSV, with more detail than the on-screen table.
features.specific: Download summary CSV writes basinlens_summary.csv with site_id, site_name, capacity Q10/Q50/Q90, mean and SD (Mt), attention score and category, and the three attention components. The file reflects the current dataset, sample count and seed.
steps: set data, samples and seed
press Download summary CSV
open basinlens_summary.csv
serves_tasks: Export a summary table of the current run

features.name: Inline method and limitations disclosure
features.general: A collapsible panel beside the results that states the model equation, how inputs are sampled, and what the analysis does not cover.
features.specific: The Methodology and limitations expander: M = A × h × φ × ρCO2 × E, triangular sampling of each input, and explicit scope caveats (the attention indicators are not containment-safety judgements).
steps: press the Methodology and limitations expander
read the equation and sampling description
read the scope limitations before interpreting results
serves_tasks: Read the method and its limitations
